title: euphorbia philora
intro: Euphorbia philora, commonly known as the "Coral Plant", is a succulent plant species native to India. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Euphorbia philora include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia and anti-pyretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Euphorbia philora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential use in the development of new medicines.
